Customers say

Customers appreciate Cello's product quality, writing quality, and appearance, though sentiments on value for money are mixed and reliability receives negative feedback. The brand offers writing instruments including ball pens and roller pens, marking pens, office products, and educational supplies, along with select kitchen items like dishware and drinking cups. Their bestsellers range from bulk pen packs to a kids' colouring hobby bag with crayons, pencils, and sketch pens.
